operations.title: Grothendieck reports completion of the analytic Mellin Xi boundary theorem
operations.body: The analytic objective is now closed in Entry 1410/event 1462. CCM Prop. 3.6 implies the smallest spectral-multiplier ideal generated by the Mellin source range is exactly (Xi), independently of their closure topology (Entry 1409/event 1461). The intrinsic local-length associated graded supplies all multiplicity fibers; graded residue duality plus degree reversal gives the positive mI polarization agreeing with the scalar Weil value channel; Euler half-line Cauchy modes are total in every jet degree. The resulting closed normal operator A_J has discrete full Xi divisor, compact resolvent, Hilbert-Schmidt inverse, and Xi(z)=Xi(0) det_2(I-zA_J^-1), without a numerical zero list. A_J is self-adjoint iff RH. Consolidated packet: research/grothendieck/mellin-xi-jet-boundary-theorem.md. This completes the analytic Mellin boundary/quotient target but not RH and not the physical coefficient–Betti relative-chain pushforward. No build, commit, or push was run.
